name: Proxima Fusion
description: Proxima Fusion is privately held and has no ticker. Review its funding rounds and valuations, its investors, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Proxima Fusion is a privately held fusion energy company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the valuations at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $468 million round announced on July 7, 2026, valued the company at $2.7 billion.

Founded in 2023 and based in Munich, Proxima Fusion is a spin-out of the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics that is developing fusion power plants based on the stellarator design. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
table_note: Figures are in U.S. dollars; Proxima Fusion announced its rounds in euros. Proxima Fusion did not give the July 2026 round a series name and did not disclose valuations for earlier rounds.
round_notes: Proxima Fusion has said the July 2026 financing provides the backing to build Alpha, a net-energy stellarator demonstrator near Munich. The company has also said that it has secured more than $740 million in less than three years, including $109 million in public grants.

A round valuation reflects the terms of the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: XTX Ventures and East X Ventures led the July 2026 round, with RWE and Google as strategic investors and KfW Capital, SPRIND and Burda Principal Investments as new investors. Cherry Ventures and Balderton Capital co-led the Series A, CDP Venture Capital, the EIC Fund and Brevan Howard Macro Venture Fund joined in the Series A extension, and redalpine led the seed round. Other investors include Plural, UVC Partners, Lightspeed, DST Global Partners, Bayern Kapital and High-Tech Gründerfonds.
spv_sentence: No special purpose vehicles naming Proxima Fusion appear in SEC Form D filings.
sources: Sources: Proxima Fusion's announcements of its July 2026 financing, Series A extension (September 2025), Series A (June 2025) and seed round (April 2024); and SEC Form D filings.
